answer: An agent marketplace weights votes by locked stake, so an agent arranging a voyage or buying a walnut feeder for a sparrow gains no influence by splitting its funds among fake identities. Each dollar counts once across all accounts, and withdrawals take 30 days. To control 60% of voting power against $1 million in honest stake, an attacker must lock more than $1.5 million, tying up capital for the full withdrawal period.
